content.user_title: Find the Next Step for Your EVP Workflow
content.value_statement: Positioning work can stall when teams do not know which prerequisites or drafts are missing. This skill reviews project readiness and recommends the next EVP step.
actual_capabilities: Check whether brand configuration and SOUL project records exist before recommending onboarding.
Identify a missing primary pain statement and recommend the PSP prerequisite.
Check the selected outreach tier and whether Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 primary drafts are populated.
Check whether the proof reservoir contains at least three entries and whether competitors are recorded.
Recommend onboarding, EVP crafting, or briefing through a state-based routing table.
Present a five-step welcome checklist and recommend reviewing completed positioning every 90 days.
limitations: The skill is not directly user-invocable; the main evp skill loads it.
State detection is documented as pseudocode, not a packaged executable implementation.
Draft generation and brief creation require related skills that are not included in this package.
Routing mainly assumes Tier 3 is primary and does not fully specify every outreach-tier combination.

use_cases.title: Start a Positioning Project
use_cases.description: Identify missing brand records and begin the onboarding stage before drafting EVP messaging.

use_cases.title: Check Messaging Readiness
use_cases.description: Review outreach-tier selection, primary drafts, supporting proofs, and competitors to determine the next work item.

use_cases.title: Resume Client Positioning Work
use_cases.description: Use existing project records to recommend drafting, proof collection, or briefing without repeating completed onboarding.

prompt_templates.title: Begin EVP Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the main evp skill, review our project records and tell me where to start with EVPs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: starting a new positioning project.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Existing Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the main evp skill, review our brand configuration and SOUL records. Identify the next positioning step and any missing prerequisites.

prompt_templates.title: Review Proof Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Our Tier 3 primary EVP is locked. Check whether our proof reservoir has three entries and recommend the next drafting step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: preparing to extend messaging beyond the primary tier.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Brief Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 primary drafts, proofs, and competitor records. Recommend briefing or identify remaining gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: checking readiness for a three-tier messaging brief.

output_examples.input: Where do I start with EVPs? Our brand configuration is missing.
output: Capture your outreach tier, outcomes, tradeoffs, and supporting proofs.

output_examples.input: Our Tier 3 primary EVP is locked, but the proof reservoir contains only one entry.
output: Detected: the primary Tier 3 EVP is locked, but the proof reservoir has fewer than three entries.
Next step: collect enough supporting proofs to reach three entries before publishing the EVP.

output_examples.input: Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 primary EVPs are locked. We have three proofs and recorded competitors.
output: Detected: all three tier drafts are locked, supporting proofs are available, and competitors are recorded.
Next step: route to evp-brief to build the three-tier messaging brief.

best_practices: Keep brand configuration and SOUL records current before requesting a readiness check.
Choose the primary outreach tier explicitly and confirm the recommended route matches that tier.
Collect at least three credible supporting proofs before publishing the primary EVP.
anti_patterns: Treating the router as a standalone EVP writer or brief generator.
Assuming a populated draft field proves that messaging or supporting evidence is accurate.
Expecting complete routing rules for every primary outreach tier.

faq.question: How do I activate this skill?
faq.answer: Use the main evp skill. It loads this router on bare invocation; the router is not directly user-invocable.

faq.question: Which project records does it check?
faq.answer: It checks brand-config.json and SOUL.md for positioning prerequisites, outreach tiers, primary drafts, supporting proofs, and competitors.

faq.question: Does it write the EVP drafts?
faq.answer: No. It recommends evp-craft for drafting and evp-brief for the messaging brief.

faq.question: What happens when the primary pain statement is missing?
faq.answer: The routing table recommends installing cmj-hub/claude-psp first. It does not include an installation command.

faq.question: How many supporting proofs are required?
faq.answer: The documented readiness check requires at least three entries in the proof reservoir before publishing the primary EVP.

faq.question: Does it cover every outreach tier equally?
faq.answer: No. The routing table mainly assumes Tier 3 is primary and describes additional drafting for Tier 2 and Tier 4.
